# Spec-owned paths: a PR that changes any of them needs the "spec change" label.
#
# Read by .github/scripts/check-spec-label.sh (workflow: spec-label.yml).
# One bash glob per line; '*' also crosses '/', so 'design/*' covers
# design/screens/x.html. Blank lines and lines starting with '#' are skipped.
# Some of these also need a change entry in docs/changes/ or design/changes/;
# that shorter list is in the script (needs_spec_log, needs_design_log).
#
# Not here on purpose: docs/changes/ (Devin updates an item's file in build
# PRs), docs/work-items.md (the register up to 023), docs/analysis/ (Devin
# writes reports), docs/screenshots/ (PR evidence).

# Behaviour spec, its map and the frozen changelog
docs/SPEC.md
docs/README.md
docs/CHANGES.md
docs/RESEARCH.md
# Kickoffs, including docs/kickoffs/archive/. An unchanged move into
# archive/ needs no label (rule 4 in the script).
docs/kickoffs/*

# Agent rules
AGENTS.md
CLAUDE.md

# Prompts (a version in use is never edited) and the env contract
backend/prompts/*
.env.example

# Look and wording
design/*

# The gate itself
.github/spec-paths.txt
.github/scripts/check-spec-label.sh
.github/workflows/spec-label.yml
